scope: Exploratory functional interpretation, not clinical concept identification. No training, fitted probe, gradients, checkpoint updates or new full benchmark evaluation.
evidence_limits: Calibration cohorts V1=128 and V4=512 are different; paired new confirmation uses the same 32 patients and noise.
Cohorts were used previously in the broader benchmark; no untouched external holdout is claimed.
Within-variable ranks remove between-variable level differences but do not remove all confounding; entries within a patient are dependent.
Input interventions have only two eligible patients per variable, selected before inference; descriptive sensitivities only.
Observed training percentiles are empirical reference ranks, not clinical normality thresholds.
Ablations remove last-step contributions only and recompute all-draw median; they do not establish the effect of removing a unit across the entire model.
A lack of a marginal correlation does not exclude a nonlinear or context-dependent concept.

ablation_verification.scope: One implementation check on the first of the 32 confirmation patients; all 48x40 positions checked. Actual GELU ablation in final step versus algebraic draw correction and recomputed median. Not an accuracy improvement.
